summary.text: Kate McCann is a Democratic state representative from Vermont's Washington-4 District who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election, also listed with the Vermont Progressive Party.
A former teachers' union leader and educator, she lives in Montpelier.

paragraphs.text: Kate McCann was born in Lancaster, New Hampshire, and lives in Montpelier, Vermont.
She graduated from White Mountains Regional High School in 1992 and earned an M.A. in curriculum and instruction from the University of Vermont in 1998.
Her career experience includes working as an educator and as chief negotiator, vice president and co-president of the Vermont teachers' union.
McCann assumed office in the Vermont House on January 4, 2023, and advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
